summary: Adds a NoEngagementFeed property and task-panel field to the Tool Controller (also saved in templates), a matching NoEngagementFeed command annotation, and marks Adaptive's at-depth link rapids with that annotation so they can be emitted as feed moves instead of G0.

pages.reason: Path/Tool/Controller.py: new App::PropertySpeed 'NoEngagementFeed' in the Feed group, added on restore for old files and read/written in templates as 'noengagementfeed'; ToolControllerEdit.ui: new 'No-Engagement feed' QuantitySpinBox inserted at row 5 above Horizontal rapid

Path/Op/Adaptive.py GenerateGCode: LinkClear G0 X/Y moves at working depth now carry the NoEngagementFeed annotation, so they become feed moves at the tool controller's No-Engagement feed when that value is non-zero (default zero keeps G0)
Constants.py: new command annotation key ANNOT_NO_ENGAGEMENT_FEED = 'NoEngagementFeed' alongside allow_unsupported; set on Path.Command.Annotations by Adaptive
